title: Our Diocese
eyebrow: ABOUT THE DIOCESE OF NORTH CAROLINA
intro: Church of the Epiphany is part of the Episcopal Diocese of North Carolina.

summaryCards.heading: Visit our diocese
summaryCards.text: Explore diocesan news, ministries, and resources.

sections.heading: Connected in faith
sections.text: Our parish belongs to a wider community, or diocese, of Episcopal congregations in central North Carolina. There are 107 Episcopal dioceses. Together, we share in worship, formation, and service. The Episcopal church is a part of the global Anglican Church. It is called the Episcopal church in the United States and in the Caribbean and Central America.
